facts: The NVMe driver is a passive library linked into an application. It maps PCI BARs and operates via MMIO; it creates no application threads.
Reads and writes submit asynchronously through queue pairs. The application polls outstanding queue pairs for completions and invokes completion callbacks.
DMA buffers and queue management provide direct userspace interaction with NVMe devices. Storage kernel bypass does not imply network kernel bypass.
